reviews.text: One of the very few clinics TO HIGHLY RECOMMEND (only 2 in Rome I think)... they recommended it to me for an emergency on Saturday and I must say to highly recommend to others... Empathic with us and with little Vasco, very kind, attentive, sensitive on every front... An added value in Rome.

Our love for our Aurora brought us to this clinic, driven by a last, desperate attempt to hear another side of the story before the "recommended" euthanasia at another clinic.
We were able to experience firsthand the welcome given, the professionalism, and the courage to do everything to save our dog. All this because she didn't need to be put to sleep, but treated with the right therapy.
The therapeutic change worked, and she's still here with us, wagging her tail when we arrived and living her life again <3.
We therefore wanted to thank Dr. Pisegna and the entire clinic staff for taking such good care of our tough-as-nails "old lady."
Well done, you are both professional and human. Thank you for your support and humanity always.

Thanks to Drs. Pisegna and Porretta, and to Claudia, Laura, and Fausta, who cared for my Raffaello with love and professionalism. My little dog was looked after for 15 years with scrupulous care and such compassion. I can't thank you enough. Giuliana

Doctor Vincenzo Pisegna...who could ever let him go?
Helpful, affectionate with his furry patients, and incredibly patient with humans. First Lola, then Maya, and now little Pippo. Doctor, he won't be leaving us!
The receptionist was also lovely, kind, and very kind: I don't remember her name, but I'll get it as soon as possible.
Thank you so much ❤️
Thank you!

I took my cat in with an injury to his paw. They made me wait a long time, then they finally saw him. The doctor gave him a quick look, injected him with an antibiotic, and sent me away without further ado 🥺 …

I wanted to thank Claudia and Fausta, who worked so hard to reschedule my appointment from morning to afternoon without making me wait another day. That time was precious for my dog, who managed to overcome a pulmonary edema. She's still with me for now. I don't know for how long, but the important thing is that she's here and she's doing well now. The empathy, helpfulness, and kindness of the receptionists definitely makes a difference! Thanks again from me and Lulù.

I've been going to this clinic since 2010. I've always had a great experience. Last year I brought my 15-year-old poodle who wasn't feeling well. On that occasion we met Dr. VALENTINA DI SANTO, an extraordinary person, both professionally and humanely. Always available even when she's not on duty. Thanking her enough is never possible. Truly. What can I say, an excellent facility with excellent staff. Keep up the good work... our animals thank you and so do we. 💪👏👏

Thank you for providing such excellent and compassionate care for a stray kitten I brought in for severe respiratory inflammation. Your helpfulness and attentiveness were top notch. Thank you also for acting pro bono, charging me only the cost of the medication.

Very kind and friendly staff. Unfortunately, they recommended antibiotics and medications for my 15-year-old cat with a heart condition, and they apparently had an adverse effect. I'll never be sure whether there was a real connection or not, but during the administration of these treatments, my big cat's deterioration became increasingly evident. Each time he ingested one of these pills, he would experience fatigue. Only to recover and experience further fatigue with the next dose. I was certainly foolish to trust them and not stop this treatment early and seek a second opinion elsewhere, but there was little I could do. Within a week, my sweet Fiocco had succumbed and gone to a better place. I'm sorry, but I will never bring my cats to this clinic again.
I love you, Fiocco, you grew up with me, and I've learned more with and thanks to you than any other human being I've ever met in my 29 years of life. A part of you will stay with me forever and I hope to see you again somewhere soon.
Dr. Pisegna is a goldmine. He's treating my dog ​​with love and perseverance. Very humble and honest. Thank you for everything.

0/10 This is the least welcoming veterinary clinic in the area. It's a good thing there are others. It was an emergency and yesterday she didn't return calls, and today, sorry, she's only taking appointments. How come? Ridiculous! The receptionist refused to give her name.

At this clinic, I found great professionalism, kindness, and care in caring for my animals. A rare and precious combination. All the staff, both doctors and nurses, are excellent.
I highly recommend it.
I went to Dr. Zeyen for an echocardiogram and he was very attentive and kind. Highly recommended.

Today, for the first time, we met veterinarian Caffarella, recommended by our veterinary team in Piazza Bologna.
Diego was warmly welcomed by the receptionist and the in-house team. Then we met Dr. Zeyen for an ultrasound/echocardiogram. He was warmly welcomed, thorough, knowledgeable, and provided a thorough explanation of the problems encountered. Thank you so much. See you at the next checkup. 🐾💓
If you have a pet at home and want to take care of it, this is a place you can't miss. The doctors and staff are highly qualified and trained.

My beloved Emma was entrusted to the care of Dr. Vincenzo Pisegna from her first months of life until her old age. He never once made a mistake, always accompanying us with professionalism, expertise, and great humanity. Knowing that Emma was in his hands gave me peace of mind at every moment, even the most delicate.
A sincere thank you also to the assistants and all the staff, always available, kind, and attentive: they made us feel welcomed and cared for with dedication and love.
It is a clinic where you find not only expertise, but also a genuine heart for animals and those who love them.

They couldn't determine through an examination that my dog ​​had a simple ear infection, even though they checked his ears. However, they immediately ordered blood tests (which are expensive) simply because he had a fever. A closer look at his ears was all they needed, too bad. 🤷🏻‍♀️
Luckily, I found something better. 👌🏻
I don't recommend this facility.

Terrible. The secretary forgot to let me in with my two French Bulldogs, who were both supposed to have an ultrasound. In July, with 40 degrees, forced into the car with the engine running to keep the air conditioning on (which is also prohibited by law), for those who know the breed, heat stroke is more likely than others. After an hour of waiting (my husband with them) we left. She made me wait at the door of the surgery, saying that the vet was sorting out "some things". All the people who arrived after me came in, except me, who had made the appointment more than a month before. Among other things, they were recommended by my trusted vet, otherwise I would have openly told them what I thought of their attitude towards the respect that should be shown towards animals. They came in, went out, went to the bar, with me always next to the entrance door. Very serious attitude. I never received a phone call apologizing for what happened. The secretary should have done something, but she wasn't able to do it. Congratulations. I've never seen so much inefficiency in one hour.

The Caffarella Veterinary Clinic has proven to be a valuable resource: professional, meticulous, honest, and always driven by a genuine concern for our cat's well-being, never recommending unnecessary tests. Despite the seriousness of his condition, thanks to Dr. Valanzuolo's expertise and compassion, we were able to spend another month and a half with him in more than dignified conditions. A sincere thank you to all the staff: I will continue to recommend this clinic whenever I can.

I went to the Caffarella Clinic for the first time, to get my poodle vaccinated. My poodle is a good miniature poodle, and all it takes is a little cuddle to calm him down. First, I brought a fecal sample, which was rejected and thrown in the trash. My fearful little dog was already alienated by that environment. I had suggested an Elizabethan collar to the doctor. I explained the problem, and the doctor replied that he was probably not traumatized enough, so he tried to muzzle him, shaking him doubly. Then they grabbed him forcefully, made him scream in pain like a wild dog. With the help of another doctor, they tied my dog's muzzle and gave him the vaccine. I remain immobile, inhibited, because everything happens so quickly, but it will never happen again. I can't understand why he didn't become a butcher instead of a veterinarian. ((I was ordered to be dewormed without a stool test)) .. I will never return. I do not recommend this environment. There are probably other excellent doctors within this clinic, but the one I met is not suited to this vocation.

We've been clients of the clinic for almost a year, and I can only recommend it to all pet owners: highly trained and dedicated staff, telephone assistance for minor issues, kindness and helpfulness.
When you have a pet that you treat like a member of the family, finding a veterinary team you can fully trust is essential, and fortunately, we found just that at the clinic, recommended by our trainer.
Carlo is very kind and competent. A friend of mine who is a marshal had spoken highly of him... I can only confirm that.

Today was one of the most difficult days of my life: we had to say goodbye to our beloved Byron forever. In this moment of profound grief, I feel the need to leave a heartfelt thank you to Dr. Sasso and the entire staff at the Caffarella Veterinary Clinic, especially Laura and Claudia, who supported us with sensitivity, professionalism, and so much love.

We entrusted ourselves to them two or three years ago, when Byron was already not well. Thanks to Dr. Sasso's skill, dedication, and dedication, we were able to give him (and ourselves) two more years filled with love. It wasn't just medical support, but a truly human journey, filled with attention, care, and respect for our dog's life.

Even today, at the moment of farewell, they welcomed and supported us with great kindness, empathy, and sincere emotion. It's rare to find people who work with such heart. We are grateful for everything you've done for Byron and for us.

Thank you, truly.

We've been going to this vet for years.
They're meticulous and attentive with our animal friends, and the competent staff shows their passion for their work.
Our dog Maya says thank you, thank you Nico.
Go elsewhere

NEGATIVE EXPERIENCE.
My dog ​​underwent an abdominal ultrasound, and the report stated, among other things, that his lungs were clear. The dog then underwent surgery for another issue, and subsequent checkups showed slow recovery and excessive fatigue. He was diagnosed with advanced lung cancer (did your vet say his lungs weren't clear?). A few days later, he died of respiratory failure due to fluid-filled lungs and masses.
If you care about the health of your puppies, I STRONGLY DO NOT RECOMMEND this clinic.

I took my cat to the emergency room because he had lost his appetite and had been vomiting since the night before.
The front desk started making a fuss, saying there weren't enough doctors to handle the visits and that maybe I should leave. But after I insisted, because I didn't care about the wait as long as someone could see him, a doctor finally examined him.
After checking the cat with an abdominal ultrasound and administering anti-nausea medication, we returned home with the agreement that if the situation didn't improve at least a little, I'd call back and consider a more thorough checkup. Hours passed and there was no improvement, so I called and was told that the morning doctor had finished her shift, the current doctor was alone and busy with another emergency, so he couldn't help me.
No attempt to find a solution, just a "Sorry, that's the situation, you'll have to sort it out yourself."
I don't usually write reviews, but this time I simply can't remain silent: this is no way to treat people who come to you because their pets are unwell.
Simply saying, "Madam, please try calling again later" or "Leave your contact information and we'll have you call back as soon as the situation calms down" would have shown a little more professionalism and concern for a suffering animal and its family who are trying to help.
My cat is still sick, and I'm taking him elsewhere, hoping to find a solution, but I've heard great things about this clinic, but I've had such an unhappy experience with it.
I want to thank the Caffarella Veterinary Clinic, and especially Laura, for the exceptional support they provided me during the process of transporting my dog ​​abroad. …
A guarantee for your furry or feathered friend. Dr. Di Carlo is an experienced and knowledgeable professional.
I expected a lower price for the cat's abdominal ultrasound.
Competent, honest, and kind. I especially thank the veterinarian Nicola Di Carlo and his colleague.

I went on the advice of a marshal from Abruzzo who has a Leonberger (a very sweet bear). I trusted him and did the right thing. It was everything I could ask for the care of my little girl. Thanks to Dr. Di Carlo and his team.
